title: TerraMind Knowledge Document
description: Structured agricultural knowledge document for RAG ingestion.

document_id.description: Deterministic document UUID v5 in terramind:kb namespace (category:crop_slug:disease_slug?)

source.description: Human-readable source identifier, e.g. USDA Extension, FAO, CABI, peer journal name

crop.description: Crop common name in English (matched to PlantWild crop token)

disease.description: Disease / condition common name in English; null for agriculture/plant care docs

content.description: Plain-text factual agricultural content (NOT fabricated — placeholder until sourced).

url.description: Publicly accessible URL of the authoritative source; placeholder until sourced.

author.description: Author, institution or issuing body name

reliability.description: Source trust tier (higher enumeration = more authoritative)

metadata.description: Arbitrary key/value payload passed through to the RAG vector store (Document.metadata).
